issues.title: THC and its variants are filed under Stimulants
issues.detail: Their infobox is missing from the export, so they fell into the wrong family.

issues.title: Methadone and Pethidine are filed under Depressants
issues.detail: Both are opioids. Their chemical class is also missing.

issues.title: Unclassified substances with an obvious family
issues.detail: These sit in Unclassified only because the wiki box leaves the class empty.
issues.proposal: Flunitrazepam, Kava and 1,3-Butanediol to Depressants. Trihexyphenidyl to Deliriants. Perazin to Antipsychotics. Cocoa to Stimulants. AET to Entactogens. Keep Blue lotus, Grayanotoxin, Inhalants and Tryptamine (compound) under Other.

issues.title: 27 recipes and extraction methods are listed as substances
issues.detail: Cupcakes, teas, teks and brews are ways to prepare a substance, not substances.
issues.proposal: Take them off the map and show each one on its parent substance's page, under a Preparation heading.

issues.title: 41 substances belong to two families but appear in only one
issues.detail: For example MDMA is a Stimulant and an Entactogen, but sits only under Stimulants.
issues.proposal: Show each one in every family it belongs to.

issues.title: Chemical class names that mean the same thing
issues.detail: Substituted amphetamine / Substituted amphetamines / Amphetamine; Arylcyclohexylamine / Arylcyclohexylamines; Indole alkaloid / Indole alkaloids; Cathinone / Substituted cathinone; Phenethylamine / Substituted phenethylamine; Substituted piperazine / substituted piperazine.
issues.proposal: Merge each group under one name (the first one listed).

issues.title: Chemical class labels that are not chemical classes
issues.proposal: Carisoprodol to Carbamate, Meclofenoxate to Choline ester.

issues.title: Five families with five substances or fewer
issues.detail: Hallucinogens (5), Antipsychotics (4), Antidepressants (2), Oneirogens (1), Anxiolytics (1). Mirtazapine, an antidepressant, sits under Deliriants as the wiki has it.
issues.proposal: Keep Hallucinogens. Group Antipsychotics, Antidepressants and Anxiolytics as one family, Prescription medicines. Keep Oneirogens. Leave Mirtazapine as the wiki has it.

issues.title: 25 substances have no chemical class
issues.detail: They show under "Chemical class not given" inside their family.
issues.proposal: Fill these in from the books and other sources as we add them.

issues.title: 19 substances have no effect list
issues.detail: They won't appear in the By effect view. Includes THC, Dextroamphetamine, Midazolam and HHC.
issues.proposal: Fill these from trip report keywords (D20) and other sources. Until then, the page says the effects aren't listed yet.

issues.title: 28 substances have no dosage data
issues.detail: Their warning intro can't show dose ranges yet.
issues.proposal: Show a clear "no reliable dose data" warning on these pages until a source fills it in.

issues.title: "Ego death" is named on 94 substances but has no effect page
issues.detail: It's one of the most searched effects.
issues.proposal: Add Ego death as an effect, with its own definition.

issues.title: 125 Shulgin compounds are not on the map
issues.detail: They are only in TiHKAL or the Shulgin Index, with no PsychonautWiki page.
issues.proposal: Add them to the map under their chemical family with a "Shulgin only" tag, and a page holding his entry (D33).

issues.title: 70 plant and fungus pages are not on the map
issues.detail: For example Papaver somniferum (opium poppy), Psilocybe and Amanita.
issues.proposal: Add a Plants & fungi family to the map, linking each plant to the substances it contains.
